sloka: उरोगतेन निष्केण भुजस्थैरङ्गदैरपि।कुण्डलाभ्यां च चित्राभ्यां मालया च विचित्रया ।। ६.७७.५ ।।
transliteration: urogatena niṣkeṇa bhujasthairaṅgadairapi।kuṇḍalābhyāṁ ca citrābhyāṁ mālayā ca vicitrayā ।। 6.77.5 ।।

translations.english: Nikumbha was shining with ornaments on his chest, golden armlets on arms, wonderful earrings and wonderful garland s holding clubs in hand, with bow like Indra's and roaring like lightning and thunder in the clouds.
